अमृततुल्य chai worth coming back for
# An affordable chai franchise with Hyderabadi Amruttulya

Open your own outlet for ₹1 lakh onwards. We use jaggery instead of regular sugar in every cup — 100% natural, unrefined, and delivered straight from the heart of rural India, crafted by farmers using traditional methods.
- **To start**: ₹1L onwards
- **Margin**: 40% – 50%
- **Space**: 100 – 200 sq ft
Why jaggery

## Every other chai stall reaches for the sugar jar.

We don't. Every cup of Hyderabadi Amruttulya chai is sweetened with jaggery instead of regular sugar. It is the single thing that separates this chai franchise from the tea stall two doors down — and the thing customers taste first.

### Unrefined by design

Jaggery is cane juice boiled down and set — not stripped white. It goes into the pot in place of refined sugar, in every cup we serve.

### A deeper flavour

Dark, faintly smoky, closer to molasses. It holds its own against ginger, cardamom and a long boil, where white sugar simply disappears into the milk.

### A shorter supply chain

Raw, unprocessed produce from farmers in rural India working by traditional methods and age-old wisdom, bought at fair prices.
Our mission

## Bridging the gap between urban and rural life

At Hyderabadi Amruttulya, we strive to bridge the gap between urban and rural life. Observing the challenges of urban living, we aim to address health concerns caused by processed and chemically produced products. Our mission is to offer you 100% natural products, delivered straight from the heart of rural India.
We are committed to providing you with raw, unprocessed and natural products, supporting a healthy and natural lifestyle. Our products are meticulously crafted by farmers using traditional methods and age-old wisdom.
“Amruttulya” means equal to nectar. That is the standard every pot is held to.
The franchise

## What an affordable chai franchise actually takes

A Hyderabadi Amruttulya chai franchise starts from ₹1,00,000. A small shop, a low entry cost and a product people already drink twice a day are the three things that make a tea franchise inexpensive to open and simple to run.
- **Profit margin**: 40%–50%
- **Space required**: 100–200 sq ft
- **Franchise cost**: ₹1Lonwards
The franchise fee starts from ₹1 lakh, and what a particular site works out at is settled on the discovery call. Margins vary with location, rent and running costs. Rent, deposit and licences are yours and sit outside the fee.

Franchise FAQ

## Questions people ask before they call

### How much does a Hyderabadi Amruttulya chai franchise cost?

A Hyderabadi Amruttulya chai franchise starts from ₹1 lakh — that is ₹1,00,000 onwards. What a particular site works out at depends on the site itself, and it is settled on your discovery call. Rent, deposit and licences are yours and sit outside the fee. Call +91 98499 98779.

### Is there a chai franchise under 2 lakhs in India?

Yes. Hyderabadi Amruttulya starts from ₹1 lakh, which puts the entry cost well under ₹2 lakh. The outlet is a 100–200 sq ft counter rather than a sit-down café, so the space and the fit-out stay small as well.

### What makes this an affordable chai franchise?

Three things. The fee starts from ₹1 lakh. An outlet needs 100–200 sq ft and runs as a counter, not a sit-down café, so the fit-out stays small. And chai is something people already buy twice a day, so the product needs no explaining.

### Is a chai franchise profitable?

Hyderabadi Amruttulya outlets work on a 40%–50% profit margin. That figure moves with location, rent and running costs, so the numbers for your own site are worked through on the discovery call.

### Do I need experience running a food business?

No. Most of our enquiries come from first-time business owners, and training is provided before you open. What that training covers for someone with no food background is walked through on the discovery call.

### How long does it take to open an outlet?

The clock runs from signed agreement to opening day, and covers site assessment, setup and training. The timeline for your city and your site is confirmed on the discovery call.

### Can I open a Hyderabadi Amruttulya outlet in Hyderabad?

Hyderabadi Amruttulya opens outlets across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad included. Which areas are free right now, and how a territory is drawn around one, is confirmed with the franchise team on +91 98499 98779.

### Do I get an exclusive territory?

Territory terms, how the radius is defined and which cities are currently open are confirmed directly with the franchise team on +91 98499 98779.

### What is Amruttulya chai?

“Amruttulya” (अमृततुल्य) means equal to nectar. It is chai served over a counter rather than at a table — strong, milky and spiced, boiled long. At Hyderabadi Amruttulya every cup of it is sweetened with jaggery in place of refined sugar.

### Why jaggery instead of refined sugar?

Jaggery is cane juice boiled down and set, rather than stripped white. It is darker and faintly smoky, so it holds its own against ginger, cardamom and a long boil where white sugar disappears into the milk. It also comes straight from farmers in rural India, which keeps the supply chain short. It is the single thing that separates this chai from the tea stall two doors down.

### Where do the tea and jaggery come from?

Raw, unprocessed produce comes from farmers in rural India who work by traditional methods and age-old wisdom, bought at fair prices, and every cup is sweetened with jaggery in place of refined sugar. The specific regions, and how supply reaches partners, are covered on the discovery call.

### What ongoing support do franchise partners get?

Training is provided before you open. What continues after that, and what it covers for your outlet, is set out on the discovery call.
